_comment: Configuration for the image branch. The adapter is provider-agnostic: skills
never name a provider, they just ask for an image. Switching from fal.ai to
an MCP happens here, without touching a single skill.
NO model slug is ever invented. Slots left at null must be resolved at
fal.ai/explore/models and written here; the tool fails rather than guess.

_models_note: Verified 2026-09-17 with REAL calls, not by probing: probing with an invalid
payload does NOT work — the queue returns 200 and the path error only shows
up on a real call. fal-ai/nano-banana/v2 returned 200 when probed and 404
Each slug here is marked verified only after a real call.
_size_keys_note: Verified 2026-09-17: fal-ai/nano-banana IGNORES image_size and returns a
1024x1024 square. It uses aspect_ratio ('16:9'). Both keys are sent: a model
that does not understand one ignores it. If one returns 422, remove it here.

_note: Example using Higgsfield. Any image-generating MCP works: change `server`
and the `tools` map to match your connector.
Declare the server in the project's .mcp.json.
MCP tools cannot read local files: upload them or pass a URL.

vertical_thumbnail.reason: Thumbnails are always 16:9 by default. If your channel publishes vertical content, move this entry back into `formats`.
